question: Do EPS revisions provide enough common-company/broker coverage for a distinct comparison to profit revisions?
source: R24 source-exclusion overlay, R25 corrected profit monthly revisions, all cached report barriers
timing: same latest180/prior365, reports strictly earlier than month-end, FY0/FY1 only
variants: EPS with values from five explicit share-basis reports withheld; report nodes retained
pairing: inner join valid profit and EPS by stock, broker, fixed FY and date before aggregation; require same latest and previous report publication dates; company median across common brokers, industry median across identical common companies
coverage: all available prior-month membership rows retained, L1/L2/L3 separate; >=5 and >=80% unchanged; no missing=0; report denominator-proxy limitations
evaluation: coverage and rank/value disagreement only; no market returns or new predictive claim
share_guard: five confirmed report contexts from R27, not the lexical false positive or all generic diluted-EPS mentions; diagnostic exclusion not assertion of erroneous source
next_gate: forecast evaluation requires frozen protocol and existing train/calibration minima; coverage alone is not incremental validity
